tools.name: crear_borrador_web
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a website for a small local business (restaurant, hairdresser, shop, clinic, tradesperson, association) or a new version of their current website. Builds a free draft and returns a link where the person can view it. Takes 15 to 60 seconds. Give either a short description

tools.name: ver_borrador
tools.description: Use this when someone has a draft link or token from crear_borrador_web and wants to know its state: business name, list of pages, whether it is still valid and until when. Read only; changes nothing.

tools.name: comprobar_dominio
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to know whether a domain name for their website is free, e.g. panaderia-ruzafa. Checks up to three endings (com, es, net, info, org, de, eu) per call; at most one of them is confirmed with the registry, the others are marked as not confirmed. Read only; registers nothing

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "crear_borrador_web" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Builds a free draft website for a small local business (restaurant, hairdresser, shop, clinic, tradesperson, association) and returns a link where the person can view it. Takes 15 to 60 seconds. Give either a short description of the business (what it does, where, what it offers, how to contact it) " → after: "Use this when someone wants a website for a small local business (restaurant, hairdresser, shop, clinic, tradesperson, association) or a new version of their current website. Builds a free draft and returns a link where the person can view it. Takes 15 to 60 seconds. Give either a short description "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
